name: Queen of Hearts
source:
Queen of Heart, the governor of Wonderland, and Ririka's older sister. A gentle and a natural airhead person.

Wonderland was governed by Queen of Hearts and other 3 knights. Few years earlier, when Wonderland was invaded, she and the knights were able to ward the enemy off but she received great injury while Knight of Spades got one as well on the face. Right before she went to recover, she named her sister, Ririka, as the next Queen. At the moment, she is in the state of deep sleep.
